result.rationale: The sale closed on December 16, 2025, but no named JV/platform was disclosed. KKR bought parallel 50% interests in two TotalEnergies holdcos. Keep one manager-level record for the common transaction, renamed and expanded to Canada.

identityResolution.name: TotalEnergies North American Solar Portfolio (KKR co-investment)
identityResolution.type: Descriptive portfolio grouping, not a disclosed legal JV/platform
legalTargets: TotalEnergies Renewables Big Sky Solar Holding I Corporation
identityResolution.acquisitionEntity: JVPTR LLC is the disclosed Maverick buyer; Big Sky buyer is UNRESOLVED
identityResolution.scope: Six utility-scale assets totaling about 1.3 GW plus 41 distributed-generation assets totaling about 140 MW in the U.S. and Canada. Big Sky Solar (184 MW), Alberta, is publicly traceable; the remaining schedule is undisclosed.
identityResolution.boundary: Count the two-target 2025 transaction once; do not separately count JVPTR, either holdco or any underlying project/SPV for the same KKR exposure.

owners.vehicle: JVPTR LLC; GP KKR Multi-Strategy Alternatives GP LLC; Big Sky buyer UNRESOLVED
owners.stake: 50% of each target; JVPTR bought 50% of Maverick voting interests

owners.vehicle: Maverick Sponsor Member, LLC via TotalEnergies Distributed Generation Operations HoldCo USA, LLC and TotalEnergies Renewables USA, LLC; Canadian chain NOT_PUBLICLY_DISCLOSED
owners.stake: 50% retained in each target; joint control and operator

ownershipResolution.structure: TotalEnergies indirectly solely owned both targets before closing; afterward each party indirectly owned 50% and jointly controlled both.
ownershipResolution.insuranceVehicles: The buyer was KKR-managed insurance vehicles and accounts. Global Atlantic-controlled life insurers hold all LP interests in the named fund; names and allocations are NOT_PUBLICLY_DISCLOSED.
ownershipResolution.formerOwnerCheck: RES sold Big Sky Solar to TotalEnergies before this deal; no other former direct target owner was identified.
ownershipResolution.accounting: Closing and operator role are confirmed; post-close accounting treatment is NOT_PUBLICLY_DISCLOSED.

operatingResolution.geography: Primarily U.S.; includes Big Sky Solar in Alberta, Canada
operatingResolution.contracting: Power is sold to third parties or marketed by TotalEnergies. KKR cited long-term contracts, but uniform 100% contracting is not shown.
operatingResolution.projectStatus: Full asset list and project-level COD/status are UNRESOLVED.
operatingResolution.customers: Third-party offtakers and TotalEnergies's U.S. power-marketing business; names NOT_PUBLICLY_DISCLOSED.
operatingResolution.strategyBasis: KKR attributed the investment to its infrastructure platform and energy-transition strategy.

acquisitionExitCheck.consideration: $1.25bn enterprise value; about $950m cash to TotalEnergies from the sale plus bank refinancing.
acquisitionExitCheck.approvals: China cleared 2025-11-10; FERC authorized the U.S. disposition 2025-12-11.
acquisitionExitCheck.laterCheck: No later sale, recapitalization, dilution, transfer, termination or signed exit was found through the cutoff. The August 2026 European deal is separate.

milestones.event: Agreement announced for KKR-managed insurance vehicles and accounts to buy 50% of the approximately 1.4 GW portfolio.
Chinese clearance disclosed both targets and 50/50 joint control; FERC approved the U.S. disposition on December 11.
Sale closed; JVPTR bought 50% of Maverick and TotalEnergies remained 50% owner/operator.

result.recommendedListAction: Correct rather than split or exclude: keep one record for the closed two-target portfolio, rename it, add Canada and the vehicle chain, and suppress underlying duplicate counts.
